cards.text:
V-MB01/001EN
Exculpate the Blaster
Normal Unit｜ Royal Paladin｜ Grade 4｜ Power 14000｜ Shield -
[AUTO](VC):When placed, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], choose one card from your soul, put all of the other cards from your soul into the drop zone, and when this unit attacks during this turn, this unit battles all of your opponent's units in one attack.
[AUTO](VC):At the end of the battle that it attacked, put two cards from your hand into your soul, retire this unit, and ride a "Blaster Blade" from your soul as [Stand]. If you could not ride, you lose.

V-MB01/002EN
Transcendence Dragon, Dragonic Nouvelle Vague
Normal Unit｜ Kagero｜ Grade 4｜ Power 15000｜ Shield -
[ACT](VC)[1/turn]:[COST][Soul-Blast 1] grade 3 or greater], and until end of turn, all of your opponent's trigger effects are nullified, and this unit gets [Power] +20000/drive -1. If you or your opponent has five cards in the damage zone, retire all of your opponent's rear-guards.

V-MB01/003EN
Sage of Salvation, Benon
Normal Unit｜ Royal Paladin｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO](RC):When placed, [COST][reveal an "Exculpate the Blaster" from your hand, and return it to your deck], search your deck for up to one "Alfred Early", reveal it, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.

V-MB01/004EN
Sage of Guidance, Zenon
Normal Unit｜ Royal Paladin｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 10000
[AUTO](RC):When placed from hand, you may reveal the top card of your deck. If that card's grade is the same as your vanguard, ride that card as [Stand], and if not, put it into the drop zone.

V-MB01/005EN

Normal Unit｜ Kagero｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000

Normal Unit｜ Kagero｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 10000

V-MB01/007EN
Alfred Early
Normal Unit｜ Royal Paladin｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield -
[AUTO](VC):When placed, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], call up to one "Blaster Blade" from your hand or soul to (RC), and that unit gets [Power] +10000 until end of turn. If you called, draw a card.

V-MB01/008EN
Blaster Blade
Normal Unit｜ Royal Paladin｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[CONT](VC):If you have four or more rear-guards, this unit gets [Critical] +1.
[AUTO](VC/RC):When placed, [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & Soul-Blast 1], choose one of your opponent's rear-guards in the front row, and retire it.

[AUTO](VC)[1/turn]:When its attack hits, [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & discard two cards from your hand], [Stand] this unit, and it gets drive -1 until end of turn.
